ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the raw report was ingested into the dashboard by the collector

reportName.description: Name of the source report file from which this record was extracted

reportFolder.description: Folder or path of the source report file from which this record was extracted

product_id.description: Product identifier from the LTA interface (OData Id)

product_name.description: Product file name from the LTA interface (OData Name)

content_length.description: Product file size in bytes (OData ContentLength)

publication_date.description: Date the product was published on the LTA interface (OData PublicationDate)

origin_date.description: Product origin date at the source (OData OriginDate)

eviction_date.description: Date the product is scheduled to be evicted from the LTA interface (OData EvictionDate)

interface_name.description: Name of the LTA interface instance the product was collected from

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service providing the product (LTA)

production_service_name.description: Name of the LTA production service instance providing the product

modification_date.description: Last modification date of the product on the LTA interface (OData ModificationDate)
